147: H5WB_actual(H5WB_t *wb, size_t need)
148: {
149:     void *ret_value; /* Return value */
150: 
151:     FUNC_ENTER_NOAPI(NULL)
152: 
153:     /*
154:      * Check arguments.
155:      */
156:     HDassert(wb);
157:     HDassert(wb->wrapped_buf);
158: 
159:     /* Check for previously allocated buffer */
160:     if (wb->actual_buf && wb->actual_buf != wb->wrapped_buf) {
161:         /* Sanity check */
162:         HDassert(wb->actual_size > wb->wrapped_size);
163: 
164:         /* Check if we can re-use existing buffer */
165:         if (need <= wb->alloc_size)
166:             HGOTO_DONE(wb->actual_buf)
167:         /* Can't re-use existing buffer, free it and proceed */
168:         else
169:             wb->actual_buf = H5FL_BLK_FREE(extra_buf, wb->actual_buf);
170:     } /* end if */
171: 
172:     /* Check if size needed can be fulfilled with wrapped buffer */
173:     if (need > wb->wrapped_size) {
174:         /* Need to allocate new buffer */
175:         if (NULL == (wb->actual_buf = H5FL_BLK_MALLOC(extra_buf, need)))
176:             HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_ATTR, H5E_NOSPACE, NULL, "memory allocation failed")
177: 
178:         /* Remember size of buffer allocated */
179:         wb->alloc_size = need;
180:     } /* end if */
181:     else {
182:         /* Don't have to allocate a new buffer, use the wrapped one */
183:         wb->actual_buf = wb->wrapped_buf;
184:         wb->alloc_size = 0;
185:     } /* end else */
186: 
187:     /* Set the return value */
188:     ret_value = wb->actual_buf;
189: 
190: done:
191:     /* Remember size of buffer used, if we were successful */
192:     if (ret_value)
193:         wb->actual_size = need;
194: 
195:     FUNC_LEAVE_NOAPI(ret_value)
196: } /* end H5WB_actual() */
